# One FAR-Trans record and leakage check (Session 1)

> **Split status:** the official time cut, item scope and evaluated users are **pending**. Everything about the split below is **provisional**.

Selected deterministically (`numpy.random.default_rng(42)`, index 11844 of 132715 eligible Buy rows sorted by transactionID). Eligibility: not January 2018; transactionID used by one customer only; a customer snapshot and an asset row exist on or before the transaction date.

Anonymisation: `customerID` (already a pseudonymous hash in the release) is truncated to 6 characters + `…`. ISIN and asset names are public market identifiers and are kept. All other values are verbatim strings from the raw CSV.

## Field status and timestamps

Prediction time = the **provisional cut** `T`, not the date of this transaction. A transaction row is an input only if its date is `< T`; rows with date `>= T` are labels (the future purchases scored by nDCG@10) and none of their fields may enter model inputs.

| File | Field | Status | Timestamp that governs it | As history (date < T) | As target (date ≥ T) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| transactions | `customerID` | observed | `transactions.timestamp` | usable | forbidden as input (label row) |
| transactions | `ISIN` | observed | `transactions.timestamp` | usable | forbidden as input (label row) |
| transactions | `transactionID` | observed | `transactions.timestamp` | usable | forbidden as input (label row) |
| transactions | `transactionType` | observed | `transactions.timestamp` | usable | forbidden as input (label row) |
| transactions | `timestamp` | observed | `transactions.timestamp` | usable | forbidden as input (label row) |
| transactions | `totalValue` | observed | `transactions.timestamp` | usable | forbidden as input (label row) |
| transactions | `units` | observed | `transactions.timestamp` | usable | forbidden as input (label row) |
| transactions | `channel` | observed | `transactions.timestamp` | usable | forbidden as input (label row) |
| transactions | `marketID` | observed | `transactions.timestamp` | usable | forbidden as input (label row) |
| customer_information | `customerID` | observed | `customer_information.timestamp` | usable if that date < T | not a label |
| customer_information | `customerType` | observed | `customer_information.timestamp` | usable if that date < T | not a label |
| customer_information | `riskLevel` | observed | `max(timestamp, lastQuestionnaireDate)` | usable if that date < T | not a label |
| customer_information | `investmentCapacity` | observed | `max(timestamp, lastQuestionnaireDate)` | usable if that date < T | not a label |

| asset_information | `assetCategory` | observed | `asset_information.timestamp` | usable if that date < T | not a label |
| asset_information | `assetSubCategory` | missing | `asset_information.timestamp` | usable if that date < T | not a label |

| asset_information | `timestamp` | observed | `asset_information.timestamp` | usable if that date < T | not a label |

In this example the customer fields are `riskLevel=Income`, `investmentCapacity=CAP_LT30K`. `limit_prices.profitability` is not part of the record and is excluded from all inputs (see below).

## Dataset-level leakage checks (computed)

**Customer profiles (`customer_information.csv`, 32468 snapshots)**

- Snapshots with `lastQuestionnaireDate > timestamp` (both non-sentinel): 12501 of 25193 (49.62%), affecting 12048 customers. Using `timestamp` alone would admit questionnaire answers from the future, so a snapshot is treated as available only from `available_from = max(timestamp, lastQuestionnaireDate)`.
- Sentinel `2000-01-01`: 130 `timestamp` values and 7275 `lastQuestionnaireDate` values (treated as unknown).
- Customers with more than one snapshot: 2263 of 29090.
- Snapshots whose `timestamp` is after the customer's first transaction: 6752 of 32468 (20.80%), for 5387 customers.
- Customers with **no** snapshot dated on or before their first transaction: 3504 by `timestamp`; 15226 by `available_from`. For them, any profile feature at the time of their earliest purchases would come from the future.
- `riskLevel`: Predicted_* 7274 of 32468 (22.40%); Not_Available 344 of 32468 (1.06%).
- `investmentCapacity`: Predicted_* 7454 of 32468 (22.96%); Not_Available 347 of 32468 (1.07%).

**Assets**

- ISINs with more than one row in `asset_information.csv`: 28. The row used must be the latest one dated before `T`.
- Buy rows dated before the earliest `asset_information` row of their ISIN: 0 of 228913 (0.00%), so a point-in-time asset row exists for every purchase.
- `limit_prices.profitability` is the return between each asset's `minDate` and `maxDate`; 523 of 807 assets have `maxDate` in November 2022. It summarises the whole price series, so it is **excluded** from inputs. Price features must be computed from `close_prices` rows dated `< T`.

**Transactions**

- Buy rows whose `transactionID` is shared with another customer (all other fields identical): 27478 of 228913 (12.00%). The same purchase therefore appears as a label for several users; how the official protocol treats these rows is pending.
- Transaction rows dated `>= T` are labels only; no aggregate (popularity counts, co-occurrence, embeddings) may be computed from them.
